recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed unless a future work-group decision intentionally adds XML schema generation for logical models or changes the current resource/datatype schema-scope policy.
issue_request: FHIR-18435 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core XML page clarification from the STU3 cycle. It asked to change the XML Schema section from saying the specification provides schemas "for all the content models it describes" to limiting that claim to resource and data type content models, because logical models do not have schemas.
initial_application: The current HL7/fhir history shows the issue applied in commit 93a1e518122819664527632651511d587a93dad4 ("GF#18432, GF#18434, GF#18435"), which changed source/xml.html to say schema definitions are provided for resource and data type content models. The Jira snapshot also records an implementation comment, "GH#8e427d8e".
additional_context: The current source/xml.html page is an active core XML format page linked from source/resource-formats.html. Its XML Schema and Schematron section now says schemas are provided for resource and datatype content models, and later source text limits the base schema to resources defined in the specification. Commit 8592e1207273b786db340efb927bb6d1dc9756c9 later changed "data type" to "datatype" as part of FHIR-25431's terminology consistency work; that spelling change preserves FHIR-18435's semantics. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting community decision for FHIR-18435.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative XML source already excludes logical models from the schema-scope claim requested by FHIR-18435.
